mechanism: Adalimumab may increase methotrexate efficacy and toxicity risk, and folic acid supplementation is used to mitigate methotrexate-induced folate deficiency when these drugs are used together, though no direct interaction exists between adalimumab and folic acid alone.
action: Continue folic acid supplementation when adalimumab is used concurrently with methotrexate; no dose adjustment needed for adalimumab-folic acid combination alone.
